reading.requirement: Current exact source SHA and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Question evidence uses spoken transcript spans only. Canonical source usage, official paired Conversation audio, rights and alignment gates remain required. No actual independent audio listen was performed during question authoring.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same-source text/audio share one group. These public practice candidates are not independent assessment or unseen-transfer evidence.

questions.prompt: What kind of place is Anna from?
questions.evidence: I am from a small town.
questions.explanation: Anna直接回答I am from a small town，所以来源地类型是小镇。D.C.是她刚来到的地方，不应把当前城市当成她的家乡；原文也没有说她来自农场。

spokenEvidence.quote: I am from a small town.

questions.prompt: Why does Pete tell Anna to call Marsha?
options: To ask Marsha to leave work.
To invite Marsha to visit Jonathan.
To tell Marsha that Anna has arrived.
answers: To tell Marsha that Anna has arrived.
questions.evidence: Remember to call Marsha at work. Tell her you’re here.
questions.explanation: Pete紧接着解释Tell her you’re here，说明电话目的是告诉Marsha自己已经到了。at work只是Marsha接电话时所在的地点，不是让她离开工作；Jonathan虽在场，但没有邀请Marsha去看他的安排。

spokenEvidence.quote: Remember to call Marsha at work. Tell her you’re here.

questions.prompt: Which apartment does Anna say she is going to at the end?
questions.explanation: 结尾Anna明确说Apartment C2, here I come，因此填C2。B4是Jonathan的公寓，D7属于Pete；需要把最后的去向与其他人物的住处区分开。

questions.prompt: What does Jonathan say about Marsha?
options: He is meeting her for the first time.
He does not know who she is.
questions.evidence: I know Marsha. She is nice.
questions.explanation: Jonathan说I know Marsha，直接表明他已经认识她，后面的She is nice也是评价已认识的人。这里不是首次见面；“不知道她是谁”与I know正好相反。

spokenEvidence.quote: I know Marsha. She is nice.

questions.prompt: What does Anna mean when she calls Marsha her roommate?
questions.evidence: I am in apartment C2. Marsha is my roommate.
questions.explanation: roommate指同住的人，且Anna在说明自己的公寓时提到Marsha，因此两人一起住。原文只说Marsha在工作，没有说她与Anna一起工作；也没有共同上学的说明。需要理解roommate，而不是只认出名字。

spokenEvidence.quote: I am in apartment C2. Marsha is my roommate.

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item exact source evidence and language comparison

blindComparison.scope: Independent source-text blind solve before seeing keys. VOA12 then received an explicitly recorded punctuation-only source correction; all question facts and answers were rechecked unchanged.
